name: Phu Day
kicker: Mother Goddess complex at Vụ Bản
summary: Give a day to Phủ Dầy, the Mother Goddess complex about 15 km southwest. The festival starts at the beginning of lunar month 3. A solar window of 9–14 April is not a fixed date. The fee and the gate hour are Check on arrival.
getThere: About 15 km southwest of the city. Check the minutes on arrival.
heroCaption: A tiled pavilion and the gates at Phủ Giầy

notice.title: The solar dates do not repeat
notice.body: The festival starts at the beginning of lunar month 3. One mapping puts 9–14 April on the 3rd–8th of that lunar month and does not say those solar days repeat. The next solar date is Check on arrival.

body: Walk the Mother Goddess complex at thôn Tiên Hương and thôn Vân Cát, xã Kim Thái, huyện Vụ Bản. Phủ Tiên Hương is nearly 7,500 m², 19 buildings, 81 bays. Phủ Vân Cát is about 1 km east, nearly 3,600 m². The 2016 listing names Phủ Dầy as a festival of the Mother Goddesses of the Three Realms, and names Liễu Hạnh the Mother of the World. Ranked a national relic by Decision 09-VH/QĐ of 21 February 1975. The complex is one of two special national relics in the province, with the Trần ground. Nearly 20 sites sit here, centered on Phủ Tiên Hương, Phủ Vân Cát, and the mausoleum.

The festival brings processions, a torch procession at Phủ Tiên Hương, chầu văn, and human chess. Check how long the complex takes, and check the fee and the gate hour, on arrival. The phủ is the sight.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: The rail cells reach Ga Nam Định in about 1 hour 40 minutes, at kilometre 87. Check the fare, and the minutes from the station out to Vụ Bản, on arrival.
